name: Subclavius
actions: Stabilizes clavicle during movement by depressing it
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Pectoralis minor
origin: Anterior surfaces of certain ribs (2–4 or 3–5)
actions: Rotates shoulder anteriorly (throwing motion); assists with inhalation
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Serratus anterior
origin: Muscle slips from certain ribs (1–8 or 1–9)
insertion: Anterior surface of vertebral border of scapula
actions: Moves arm from side of body to front of body; assists with inhalation
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Trapezius
insertion: Acromion and spine of scapula; clavicle
actions: Elevates shoulders (shrugging); pulls shoulder blades together; tilts head backwards
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Rhomboid major
actions: Stabilizes scapula during pectoral girdle movement
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Rhomboid minor
origin: Cervical and thoracic vertebrae (C7 and T1)
actions: Stabilizes scapula during pectoral girdle movement
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Abductor pollicis brevis
insertion: Lateral base of proximal phalanx of thumb
actions: Moves thumb away from body
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Opponens pollicis
actions: Moves thumb across palm to touch other fingers
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Flexor pollicis brevis
insertion: Lateral base of proximal phalanx of thumb
actions: Flexes thumb
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Adductor pollicis
origin: Capitate bone; bases of metacarpals 2–4; front of metacarpal 3
insertion: Medial base of proximal phalanx of thumb
actions: Moves thumb toward body
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Abductor digiti minimi
insertion: Medial side of proximal phalanx of little finger
actions: Moves little finger away from body
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Flexor digiti minimi brevis
insertion: Medial side of proximal phalanx of little finger
actions: Flexes little finger
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Opponens digiti minimi
actions: Moves little finger across palm to touch thumb
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Lumbricals
origin: Palm (lateral sides of tendons in flexor digitorum profundus)
insertion: Fingers 2–5 (lateral edges of extensional expansions on first phalanges)
actions: Flexes each finger at metacarpo-phalangeal joints; extends each finger at interphalangeal joints
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Palmar interossei
origin: Side of each metacarpal that faces metacarpal 3 (absent from metacarpal 3)
insertion: Extensor expansion on first phalanx of each finger (except finger 3) on side facing finger 3
actions: Adducts and flexes each finger at metacarpo-phalangeal joints; extends each finger at interphalangeal joints
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: Dorsal interossei
insertion: Both sides of finger 3; for each other finger, extensor expansion over first phalanx on side opposite finger 3
actions: Abducts and flexes the three middle fingers at metacarpo-phalangeal joints; extends the three middle fingers at interphalangeal joints
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46495

name: External obliques; internal obliques
actions: Twisting at waist; also bending to the side
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46485

name: Transversus abdominis
actions: Squeezing abdomen during forceful exhalations, defecation, urination, and childbirth
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46485

name: Rectus abdominis
actions: Sitting up
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46485

name: Quadratus lumborum
actions: Bending to the side
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46485

name: Diaphragm
actions: Inhalation; exhalation
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46485

name: External intercostals
origin: Rib superior to each intercostal muscle
insertion: Rib inferior to each intercostal muscle
actions: Inhalation;exhalation
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46485

name: Internal intercostals
origin: Rib inferior to each intercostal muscle
insertion: Rib superior to each intercostal muscle
actions: Forced exhalation
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46485

name: Superior rectus
origin: Common tendinous ring (ring attaches to optic foramen)
actions: Moves eyes up and toward nose; rotates eyes from 1 o’clock to 3 o’clock
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Inferior rectus
origin: Common tendinous ring (ring attaches to optic foramen)
actions: Moves eyes down and toward nose; rotates eyes from 6 o’clock to 3 o’clock
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Lateral rectus
origin: Common tendinous ring (ring attaches to optic foramen)
actions: Moves eyes away from nose
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Medial rectus
origin: Common tendinous ring (ring attaches to optic foramen)
actions: Moves eyes toward nose
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Inferior oblique
insertion: Surface of eyeball between inferior rectus and lateral rectus
actions: Moves eyes up and away from nose; rotates eyeball from 12 o’clock to 9 o’clock
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Superior oblique
insertion: Surface of eyeball between superior rectus and lateral rectus
actions: Moves eyes down and away from nose; rotates eyeball from 6 o’clock to 9 o’clock
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Levator palpabrae superioris
actions: Opens eyes
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Orbicularis oculi
actions: Closes eyelids
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Masseter
actions: Closes mouth; aids chewing
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Temporalis
actions: Closes mouth; pulls lower jaw in under upper jaw
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Lateral pterygoid
actions: Opens mouth; pushes lower jaw out under upper jaw; moves lower jaw side-to-side
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Medial pterygoid
actions: Closes mouth; pushes lower jaw out under upper jaw; moves lower jaw side-to-side
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Sternocleidomastoid
actions: Rotates and tilts head to the side; tilts head forward
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Semispinalis capitis
origin: Transverse and articular processes of cervical and thoracic vertebra
actions: Rotates and tilts head backward
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Splenius capitis
origin: Spinous processes of cervical and thoracic vertebra
actions: Rotates and tilts head to the side; tilts head backward
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484

name: Longissimus capitis
origin: Transverse and articular processes of cervical and thoracic vertebra
actions: Rotates and tilts head to the side; tilts head backward
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, chapter 11; source module m46484
